note: P3807 (Pro 5:18) — let your fountain be blessed; rejoice in the wife of your youth. (blessed = optative blessing, qualifier.)

dims.v: rejoicing — glad delight in the wife of one's youth
the husband's joy and delight in his own wife, the sanctioned counter to illicit desire
the rejoicing coupled to the blessing invoked on the marriage

samach (rejoice/be glad) — the bright turn of ch.5: covenant joy in 'the wife of your youth' set against the bitter wormwood of the strange woman. Delight rightly placed. The BLESSING (barak) on the fountain is the qualifier.
